request.brief: Original quiet warm noir accompaniment using locally modelled/synthetic instruments; no provider music and no live recordings.

samples.listenFor: Quiet modeled nylon-string plucks, the programmed D-A-C-D phrase, restrained brush/bone pulse, warm bell and muted brass. Evaluate whether the synthetic instruments fit the identity on headphones and a phone; no live-performance claim.

request.prompt: Compose a 30-second instrumental audition for Muerta Poker, an intimate premium gothic Día de los Muertos card game. D minor, exactly 100 BPM, 4/4 throughout. Sparse, softly damped nylon guitar carries the four-note identity D–A–C–D; recognizable, unhurried, repeated sparingly. Quiet dry bone and wooden contacts, a brushed frame drum, soft shaker, occasional damped warm brass bell, and low muted brass for restrained support. The mood is warm nocturnal candlelight and engraved bone, dark but inviting. Leave generous midrange and transient space for card stops and short win sounds. No voices or choir, no mariachi parody, no EDM, no horror drone, no casino coins, no applause, no rock drums, no bright cymbals, no sustained victory melody. Start directly in a settled accompaniment; avoid a cinematic intro, build or final triumphant cadence. Keep the instrument family and energy consistent for all 30 seconds. This is an audition excerpt, not a promised seamless loop. Provide melody, percussion and atmosphere stems if supported. Loudness will be measured and edited externally to −24 LUFS-I with true peak no higher than −3 dBTP.

mixRules: Preserve approved per-cue levels; one foreground voice; bounded overlapping tails.
Foreground cue ducks music 6 dB with 80 ms attack / 450 ms release.
No success sound on loss; no continuous coin shower.
Meter integrated program and true peak after edits; runtime combined master ≤−1 dBTP.
Phone and headphone audition required before approving the full 42 briefs.
Do not upload licensed stock recordings to generative services as reference material.
